verdict: Yes. Nish Hair from Mumbai pitched 100% human hair extensions on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal, with strong revenue. Hair extensions and toppers are a growing market, and India is a major source of human hair.
angle: Women with thinning hair, brides and fashion buyers use extensions and toppers. Quality grading and colour matching are key. Salons and online sales work well, and consultations help reduce returns.
